verdict.rationale: Godot's source is hosted on GitHub under the permissive MIT license with no royalties or restrictions (godot-gh-2, godot-docs-16, godot-docs-23), full compilation instructions are documented for all platforms (godot-gh-3), and community evidence confirms active core-engine contribution workflows with PR review (godot-comm-1), demonstrating developers genuinely read/modify/rebuild the engine when needed. Missing for 10: no dedicated architecture/internals documentation excerpt in the pack detailing how to navigate or modify the engine's C++ core beyond build instructions.
